checks.question: Modify the existing mounting washer by increasing the central bore radius from 10 mm to 12 mm. Use the supplied model and program, keeping one real, closed, connected solid; do not fake holes with materials. Input dimensions are in millimetres. Export in metres, right-handed coordinates with Z up, bottom at Z=0. The dimensional tolerance is 0.3 mm.
